title: Get ready
introManager: After a fresh install everything starts empty. Work down the list; you can stop and come back any time. Basics and Keep it safe are for the whole Aquarium (owner and admins only). Your connections are yours: every person gets this list and sets up their own.

roles.heading: What each role can do
role.owner.can: Everything: settings, model keys, people, WhatsApp bridges and mailboxes
role.owner.cannot: Hand over ownership in the app (done on the server); read other people's private items, unless senior access is turned on in settings
role.admin.can: Invite people and change their roles; change settings, tools and model keys; use every assistant tool
role.admin.cannot: Make someone owner; manage WhatsApp bridges or mailboxes; read other people's private items (unless the owner turns on senior access, and then only members' and viewers')
role.member.can: Chat with the assistant; their own private chats and files; everything shared; their own Google and VPN
role.member.cannot: See other people's private items; change settings; let the assistant run commands on the server
role.viewer.can: Read what is shared; chat with the assistant using the tools allowed for viewers
role.viewer.cannot: Have the assistant write files; change settings; see other people's private items
roles.note: Each person's own Google account, VPN and network folders are theirs alone; owner and admins see only whether they are set up.
